sentences.text: Bacteroides caccae is a ubiquitous anaerobic bacterium and a member of the human gut microbiota.
A polysaccharide utilisation locus gives it a pathway for depolymerising chondroitin sulfate, a common glycosaminoglycan.
Comparative faecal metagenomics found this commensal more abundant in children from Atlanta than in children from Mozambique.
It is not a common cause of bloodstream infection, although single cases have been reported.
